Now delete the lock file to signal the dashboard that the RCA is ready.
Investigation for SAME-3952 is complete. Here is the RCA:

---

Hi Arjenelle ,

I investigated order SA260831-72577904 and found it stuck at CREATED status with the order process in ERROR state. Here is what happened.

The order was placed on 31 August 2026 at 08:01:58 UTC via ApplePay (Checkout.com ApplePay flow) on the SA store for a total of 1,259 SAR. The payment was successfully authorised — the PaymentTransaction entry shows AUTHORIZATION with status ACCEPTED for 1,259 SAR at 08:02:17. The paymentInfo, billing address, payment address, and delivery address are all present and linked correctly. So the payment side is healthy.

The order process (order-process-v25-69-SA260831-72577904-1788163337560) started and executed three actions successfully: checkPartialPaymentEnabled (which set the order status to CREATED), sendOrderAcknowledgementEmail, and processOrderAnalytics. The process then errored at the next step — checkExternalEnabledAction. The process is now in ERROR state, which means no further actions will execute automatically.

Two anomalies in the DB state point to the root cause:

1. The order header has a NULL deliveryMode. The order entry (entry 0) has the delivery mode set to sa-delivery-calendar-PSND, but this was not propagated to the order header. Several actions in the order process rely on order.getDeliveryMode() being non-null.

2. There is an ExternalService entry linked to the order with all fields NULL (provider, status, serviceProduct, serviceID are all empty). This is a partially initialised external service record that should not exist for a standard product order. When CheckExternalEnabledAction retrieves order.getExternalServiceEntries() and processes them, this malformed entry causes a runtime exception — likely a NullPointerException — which puts the process into ERROR state.

No consignments were ever created because the process never reached the checkOrder or splitOrder steps, which are downstream of checkExternalEnabled. The order is therefore stuck at CREATED with no fulfilment path.

This is the same pattern observed in SAME-3285 (October 2025), where ApplePay orders on the SA store failed to convert to real orders despite payment being captured at the gateway. That ticket was resolved as Fixed, confirming this is a recurring ApplePay checkout flow issue specific to the SA store.

The remediation is to restart the order process from checkExternalEnabled. This requires a Groovy script that cleans up the malformed external service entry, sets the order header deliveryMode from the order entry, and creates a new order process instance. I do not have a reusable PC ticket for this remediation type — let me know if you would like me to create one.

Thanks,

Aryan.

---

RCA saved to `ticket-rca/SAME-3952.md`. Lock file deleted. No reusable PC ticket was found for order process restart remediation.
